### Context

A refresh with dark saved showed light. With the later starting-theme step turned off, dark stayed.

### What is broken

After a refresh, the account page shows the light theme even though the saved theme is dark.

### Why it is broken

The page asks the part that supplies saved account preferences, the profile service, for the saved theme, and the profile service returns dark. A separate step that sets a starting theme runs after that and replaces dark with light. A local test reproduced dark becoming light. With that later step turned off, dark stayed, which confirms this cause.

### How to fix it

Skip setting the starting theme once a saved theme has loaded, so a refresh keeps dark. This is a small change to one step. Choose hotfix because the fix is small and safe.

### What is broken

Refreshing the account page resets the saved dark theme to light instead of retaining dark.

### Why it is broken

The part that supplies saved account preferences, the profile service, returns `{"theme":"dark"}`, and the page applies it. A separate step that sets the default theme then overwrites dark with light. The local test `node --test test/profile-theme.test.mjs` reproduced this reset; disabling the later default-setting step retained dark, confirming the overwrite cause.

### How to fix it

Skip default-theme initialization after a saved theme has loaded, at `src/profile-theme.ts:62`, so refreshing retains dark. This is a small, safe change. Choose hotfix because the overwrite is confirmed and the fix is narrowly scoped.
